variants.name: 1 つの値を configMapKeyRef で受け取る・同じ名前の値を変えて札で入れ替える

move:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-config
data:
  DATABASE_URL: postgres://reserve@db-staging:5432/reserve
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: city-reserve:2.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: web-config
              key: DATABASE_URL
switch:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-config
data:
  DATABASE_URL: postgres://reserve@db-staging-2:5432/reserve
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
      annotations:
        config-version: "2"
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: city-reserve:2.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: web-config
              key: DATABASE_URL
